description: This file defines a custom Android view class 'SlidingTabStrip' used as a component for tabbed navigation interfaces, managing drawing indicators, dividers, and handling tab selection updates.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that acts as a visual indicator strip for tabs, including indicators, dividers, and handling drawing and state updates.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface for providing indicator and divider colors for tabs.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: A default implementation of TabColorizer with arrays of indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom TabColorizer for coloring the tabs.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets the colors for the selected tab indicator.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets the colors for the dividers between tabs.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected tab position and offset when the page changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the custom drawing of the indicator, bottom border, and dividers.
